description: This file contains benchmark classes for measuring message queueing performance using ADO.NET with SQL Server, including setup, configuration, and benchmarking methods.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: A concrete benchmark class for SQL Server message queueing performance, inheriting from MessageQueueingBenchmark.

classes.name: MessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the setup and benchmarking logic for message queueing performance tests, parameterized by database invariants and size parameters.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the database connection pool for SQL Server.

methods.name: GlobalSetup (in MessageQueueingBenchmark)
methods.description: Sets up the payload, queue IDs, and database connection for the benchmark.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the database state before each benchmark iteration by truncating the message table.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Performs the message queueing operation in parallel, simulating concurrent message publishing.
